objects: one complete-card-admitted physical spell card with fixed ordinary-mana Surge
state_writes: one selected alternative-cost marker and ordinary mana payment
costs: one fixed ordinary Surge mana cost in place of the mana cost; ordinary increases and additional costs remain in the total
timing: the option is offered only after the caster cast another spell in the current turn
targets: spell targets remain independent from Surge eligibility
choices: the caster may select the normal cost or Surge when eligible
hidden_information: eligibility and the selected option are public
layers: the shared current-component query gates the intrinsic ability
replacement_effects: cost-generated zone moves continue through their canonical replacement owner
copy: copied, granted, and text-changed Surge remain unsupported
control_change: eligibility belongs to the current caster
zone_change: a stale offer cannot authorize a new card incarnation
source_leaves: leaving the offered casting zone invalidates the offer

variants: prior spell cast in the same turn

implementation.supported_slice: One intrinsic fixed ordinary-mana Surge declaration in a nonteam Commander game on a complete-card-admitted spell.

known_blockers: variable, hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, nonmana, copied, granted, text-changed, repeated, and incomplete-card forms
